hello.text: Two hands? Good. I've got more work than daylight, and more trouble than both.

t0.text: Kobolds out of the old mine, at my stores every night. Rats in the barns. Bandits off the hills taking what the kobolds leave. And Mother says there's a barrow under that hill, which helps nobody.

t1.text: Mother, that's Gran to everyone. Rowan, my eldest, who thinks he's a hero. Two hands who don't. My sister farms at Westhill, west under the hills. We don't talk.

mended.text: Marta came by Sunday. First time in eleven years. Brought bread, said it was too much for one house. It wasn't. Mother cried. Don't tell her I said so.
